edition_statement: Plutarch, Moralia, vol. 3, ed. Grēgorios N. Vernardakēs, Leipzig: Teubner, 1891 (Perseus 4.0 digitization, perseus-grc2; EpiDoc/CTS conversion 2019)
issues: KG node metadata.cts_urn says tlg0007.tlg103, but the verified URN for De fato is tlg0007.tlg108 (tlg103 is a different Moralia treatise) — KG metadata should be corrected separately; KG not modified per task constraints.

Node description cites Hubert Teubner 1929 / De Lacy-Einarson LCL 405 as critical editions; the only openly licensed digitized edition available is Vernardakes Teubner 1891 (Perseus), which is what was ingested.
CTS section numbering is 0-11: Perseus numbers the proem (568b-c) as section 0; conventional chapter citation is 1-11.
4 editorial lacunae (<gap reason='lost'/>) in the Vernardakes text rendered as ' … ' (no text composed).
Initial TLG search misses for one sample were caused by line-break hyphenation in the TLG E files (e.g. 'σα-φῶς'), not by text divergence; alternate substrings from the same passages all hit.
